user.title: Create a combined outlet
user.description: Select at least two physical outlets. Measurement sensors are detected automatically from their devices. No helpers or YAML required.

data_description.switches: Select two or more individual outlets. Groups are not allowed.

measurements.title: Choose measurements and visibility
measurements.description: Untick any measurement the combined outlet should not show. Exported energy is off by default.

data_description.hide_sources: Hides the physical outlets' entities. They keep working; you control them through the combined outlet.

error.at_least_two: Choose at least two different outlets.
error.physical_switches_only: Choose physical outlets with their own device, not groups or virtual switches.
error.no_common_measurements: No common measurements were detected on all selected devices. Check that the sensors are enabled and assigned to the original devices.
error.already_configured: This combination of outlets is already set up.

abort.already_configured: This combination of outlets is already set up.

init.title: Measurements and visibility
init.description: Untick any measurement the combined outlet should not show. Changes reload the integration.

data_description.hide_sources: Hides the physical outlets' entities. They keep working; you control them through the combined outlet.
